Name: Better Theater
Author: XiaobaiTian
Description:
优化电影院体验

抓娃娃机：可以在开始前选择该局游戏的次数（对应价格会增加，每3次500金，不足三次每次200金，最大30次）
零食售货柜台：可以为自己购买24种小零食了，如果邀请了其他NPC一起看电影，需要先给他们买完才能再自己买

Give you a better Theater experience:

CraneGame: now you can choose the lives for a round of CraneGame, correspondly, you will cost more money for a round of game.(200 gold for one life, and every 3 lives you can get a 100 gold discount)
ConcessionSeller: now you can buy any concession for yourself, and put them into your bag, and even eat them for energy and health recover, if you invite a NPC
to watch a movie together, after ordering for him/she firstly, , you can buy concessions for yourself

2024/6/17
增加了零食在星露谷餐吧的销售选项，周一至周六各4种，周日随机4种，都是铱星品质，每种每天限量10份
修复了一个小bug，现在零食作为一个单独的“零食”类别（Category：-30），不会参与烹饪或者其他类型的收集图鉴
Now you can buy concessions in Gus's Saloon (The Stardrop Saloon), you can buy certain 4 types of concession from Monday to Saturday, and on Sunday you can buy random 4 types of concession, each concesion is Iridium Quality and has 10 limit on each day.
Fix a bug, now concession will be a seperate category called Snack and the category number is -30, these concessions no longer show in the collections of cooking or other collections.

2024/6/22
现在为零食增加了对应的NPC喜好，零食现在也是普遍喜欢的礼物了
现在不限制玩家进入电影院的次数了，多人游戏未测试过，另外如果添加这个模组的这周已经看过电影，下周才能生效
（这些功能都可以在配置中关闭，默认是打开的）
Add NPC taste for concessions, and Snacks were setted as Universal_Liked gift
Add a choice in config file to unrestrict the time limit for entering Theater and watching a movie, you can watch as much times as you want, as if you have enough tickets. Note that if you have watched a movie in this week, add this mod will unrestrict the limit on next week, rather effected immidiately.
(alse these fucntions can be closed in config file, default is true)

后续计划：
1、增加烹饪配方；
2、增加配置文件；
3、增加零食的buff效果；
4、其他~
